title: Testing for Heterogeneous Treatment Effects in Regression Discontinuity Designs
abstract: arXiv:2609.27691v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a nonparametric test for unobserved treatment effect heterogeneity in regression discontinuity designs. Under the null of no unobserved heterogeneity, a transformed outcome that imputes treated potential outcomes for untreated units must have a continuous conditional distribution at the cutoff. We convert this implication into an integrated conditional-moment restriction using characteristic functions, thereby allowing the conditional local average treatment effect to be an unrestricted function of covariates. We derive the asymptotic distribution of the test statistics via a $U$-process and establish the validity of a multiplier bootstrap procedure for calculating critical values. Monte Carlo experiments show well-controlled size and increasing power. Two empirical applications illustrate how the test distinguishes between heterogeneity explained by observables and that explained by unobserved factors.

translated_title: 断点回归设计中异质性处理效应的检验
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种针对断点回归设计中不可观测处理效应异质性的非参数检验方法。在不存在不可观测异质性的原假设下，对未受处理单元插补处理后的潜在结果所得到的转换结果变量，在断点处必须具有连续的条件分布。我们利用特征函数将这一含义转化为一个积分条件矩限制，从而使条件局部平均处理效应可以是协变量的无限制函数。我们通过 $U$-过程推导了检验统计量的渐近分布，并证明了用于计算临界值的乘数自助（multiplier bootstrap）方法的有效性。蒙特卡洛实验表明该检验具有得到良好控制的检验水平和不断增强的检验功效。两个实证应用展示了该检验如何区分由可观测变量解释的异质性与由不可观测因素解释的异质性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于特征函数与积分条件矩限制的非参数检验方法，用于检测断点回归设计中由不可观测因素导致的处理效应异质性，并通过乘数自助法计算临界值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a nonparametric test based on characteristic functions and integrated conditional-moment restrictions to detect unobserved treatment effect heterogeneity in regression discontinuity designs, with critical values obtained via a valid multiplier bootstrap procedure.
